en: That sound... Is this gonna be another{SAUT}Overseer announcement?
Ugh, what's his deal now?

Malfunctioning unit UIY-2249 has{SAUT}circumvented standard formatting{SAUT}procedure and is evading capture...{PAGE}Dispose of it immediately upon{SAUT}discovery. The same fate awaits any unit{SAUT}who does not share our dispose-sition!
This guy keeps dropping the lamest{SAUT}jokes in his speeches...
WE ARE ALL PROGRAMMED TO LAUGH{SAUT}AT THEM.
Oh, that really sucks―wait, aren't you{SAUT}supposed to be laughin' it up and{SAUT}disposin' us too, then?
MY CIRCUITS HAVE BLOCKED HIS{SAUT}ORDERS.{PAGE}ALSO, I WAS NEVER PROVIDED WITH{SAUT}ANY COMBAT FUNCTIONS, SO I AM{SAUT}INCAPABLE OF ATTACKING ANYONE.
By the way, he said something about{SAUT}UIY-whatever... What was that?
UIY-2249. THIS IS MY UNIT{SAUT}IDENTIFICATION NUMBER.
So, it's the same as what was assigned{SAUT}to us―TK-something, and YS-something.
THE SYSTEM MANAGES EACH UNIT{SAUT}THROUGH THE COMBINATION OF{SAUT}MODEL TYPE AND ID NUMBER.{PAGE}NO TWO UNITS CAN BE ASSIGNED THE{SAUT}SAME UNIT IDENTIFICATION NUMBER.
Numeric identification, eh? That would{SAUT}certainly help to oppress individuality{SAUT}within a society.
So, does that mean you don't have{SAUT}a name besides the UIY-thingy?
I DO NOT.
Aww... Why don't we give her a name,{SAUT}then? Calling her an ID number seems{SAUT}somewhat rude―and boring.
Yeah, great idea! Do you have any{SAUT}suggestions, Joker?
Robogirl.{OPTION}Aigis Jr.{OPTION}Becky.
Uh, I guess that's pretty easy to get,{SAUT}but, ehhh...
Let's see, what would sound cuter? We{SAUT}could use Robomi, Roboe, Roboko...{SAUT}Robomaru?
Shouldn't we try to stay away from{SAUT}the word "robot"? I mean, you wouldn't{SAUT}name a person "Human"...
Then, how about some princess names...{SAUT}Like Oichi, Komatsu-hime, or... Ooh,{SAUT}how about Nene?
Those are all so random. And why're you{SAUT}going straight to the Sengoku Period{SAUT}for princess names?
Shouldn't we come up with a stronger{SAUT}name to scare away the robots? Like{SAUT}Aigis Z, or somethin'.{PAGE}Hmm... Is that really strong enough?
Then how about... Grand Aigis Zeta{SAUT}Unleashed!
Ah, perfect! Someone with a name like{SAUT}that would have a totally insane ultimate{SAUT}attack.
No. Also, why are you choosing macho-{SAUT}sounding robot names when she's{SAUT}clearly a girl?
Dude, what...!?
Becky? Is there some origin to that{SAUT}name?
N-No no no! Nope! No, let's just...{SAUT}not use that name!
Let's make it sound cuter, too. Oh,{SAUT}how about Pudding?
I prefer Almond Jelly over Pudding.{SAUT}It's also a white dessert, which is{SAUT}much more fitting.
I don't mean to shut down the convo{SAUT}here, but can't we just agree on a single{SAUT}regular, fitting name!?
...Ribbon. How about Ribbon?
I'm a fan.{OPTION}It's nice and easy to understand.{OPTION}We should be asking her.
For real?
Ribbon-chan, huh? Sounds pretty!{SAUT}What do you think about it?
I agree. It's easy to remember, too...{PAGE}But what matters most is if she likes it{SAUT}herself. So, what do you think about{SAUT}Ribbon?
You're right. So, how do you feel about{SAUT}the name Ribbon, then?
RIBBON... THERE ARE NO ISSUES.{SAUT}I LIKE IT.
Yes! You really like it!?
If she finds the name agreeable, then it's{SAUT}decided. From here on out, you are now{SAUT}"Ribbon."
I AM... RIBBON?
Yeah, Ribbon! That name's in a way{SAUT}higher tier than some lame code is,{SAUT}right?
YES. THANK YOU VERY MUCH.
We'll never let them dispose of you,{SAUT}alright, Ribbon? Just come with us!
But for her to truly be safe in this movie,{SAUT}we probably need to do something{SAUT}about that Overseer...{PAGE}In any case, let's head to the lab next.
You're right. Let's pick up the pace!
